title: PolyGate Stored Policy Version
description: A single persisted policy version record. The ConfigMap keeps the active version plus the most recent 20 full version records. The nested 'policy' object is validated separately against policy.schema.json.

version.description: Monotonically increasing version number. Never reused, even on rollback.

change_note.description: Required audit note describing the change.

rollback_from.description: If produced by a rollback, the version number it copied content from; otherwise null.

policy.description: Full PolicyDraft content; validated separately against policy.schema.json.
